four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: partial -- the commissioned lit-pull (targeted_review_threat_modulated_defensive_path_selection: Fanselow PIC, Mobbs 2007, Evans/Branco 2018) grounds a graded bias plus a threshold categorical override. In biology both stages read a learned, outcome-grounded threat estimate for each candidate path. Here the per-leaf estimate comes from an untrained E2 and an occupancy-like residue channel. That is the signature of a missing prerequisite (a learned threat map), not of a failed mechanism.
four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: missing -- (a) a trained E2 world head. 919 and this replay are untrained, and E2 has no waking world objective (GFLAG-0485, GFLAG-0491: ree_core does no waking gradient learning at defaults). (b) A harm valence written from harm events. The residue harm channel is written with z_harm.norm() on every sense() tick (agent.py:5634-5650) from an untrained HarmEncoder, so it may be an occupancy map (driver CHANGE 3).
four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: partial -- inert-by-defect on the harm input. _decomposition_harm_penalty (hippocampal/module.py:1128-1153, unchanged since 919) averages the harm valence over ALL rollout_horizon predicted states, and all but the first are driven by zero-action padding (leaves are single primitives [0],[1],[2]). In this run, rollout_horizon = 30, so 29 of the 30 averaged states follow zero-action padding. The drift is measured here: the median end/mean pairwise predicted-state distance ratio is 4.74 over 243 units (red-team recompute). This is the same shape as GFLAG-0485 (>98% of E3 across-candidate variance comes from steps >5). Stage 1 harm_bias is clamped at harm_bias_scale on 99.2% of leaves (valence_bounding_enabled default False), so it is a constant offset: neutralising default. Stage 2 is discriminative (T = 0.078) but not harm-informed.
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: adequate for this diagnostic -- 919's HAZARD_TUNED overlay reproduced (config asserted equal to 919's _arm_flags); GT separates the leaves on 223 of 243 units
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: adequate -- C1 is decisive and non-degenerate. The anti reading in C2 survives the misspecified chance null (the chosen index is non-uniform, P(idx0) = 0.144): a marginal-preserving permutation null (red-team recompute, 5000 draws) gives z = -2.76, p = 0.0026; the best-constant-index null gives -0.197; the harm-only-separated subset (219 units) gives z -2.63. Characterisation limit: the pooled anti signal is carried by 2 of 5 seeds (47: 0.171 vs chance 0.333; 71: 0.179 vs 0.363). Seeds 11/23/3 sit at chance. No seed tracks harm. Per-unit Spearman(penalty, GT key) is bimodal (129 negative / 11 zero / 102 positive, median -0.5, mean -0.10). Both anti and neither route 919 to non_contributory. F6 (penalty horizon vs GT horizon) is a property of the mechanism's input, not a defect of the GT, which scores what the leaf controls (1 executed step per single-primitive leaf).
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: partially coupled -- the executed action equals the Stage-2 kept leaf's first action on 29.2% of Stage-2-active units, against 16.3% for a discarded leaf (red-team recompute, n=486). Stage 2 reaches behaviour above the discarded rate, but on a minority of calls. Its input is coupled but not harm-informed (starved upstream plus defect).
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate for the diagnostic (243 / 223 units vs floors of 30). The 919 target used an untrained agent by design.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-09-25 failure-autopsy V3-EXQ-1087, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1087_2026-09-25 (orchestrate-20260924-1707, user standing delegation)]: V3-EXQ-1087 (diagnostic, excluded from scoring) is the successor the 2026-09-23 conditional required. It replays V3-EXQ-919's untrained ARM_SELECTION_ON regime (5 seeds, config asserted equal, probe-OFF control action mismatch 0) and records every Stage-2 call's per-leaf harm_penalty with a ground truth from executing each leaf in a deep-copied env. RESULT: the harm input is DISCRIMINATIVE but NOT HARM-INFORMED. The Stage-2 tolerance-tie rate is 0.078 (n=243; the high-tie route did not fire). But the kept leaf is a ground-truth-best leaf LESS often than chance: pooled excess -0.070, z -2.23 (marginal-preserving permutation z -2.76), n=223; -0.197 below the best-constant-index null. The anti signal is carried by 2 of 5 seeds. It tracks harm on no seed. Stage 1 sits at its clamp on 99.2% of leaves (a constant offset). The kept leaf's first action was the executed action on only 29% of Stage-2-active units. Cause, from the code: _decomposition_harm_penalty averages the residue harm valence over all rollout_horizon predicted states of a single-primitive leaf, and all but the first step are zero-action padding through an untrained E2 world head (GFLAG-0485: E2 has no waking world objective). The harm channel is written with z_harm.norm() on every tick, so it partly tracks occupancy. Under the driver's pre-registered refinement (T <= 0.20 and not harm-tracking -> non_contributory; queue-time CHANGE 3), V3-EXQ-919's weakens re-adjudicates to NON_CONTRIBUTORY. This REFINES the 2026-09-24 ratified two-branch rule, under which a low tie rate alone would have satisfied the condition. It closes the premise that rule left implicit, that a discriminative input is a harm-informed one, which this run measures false. This is independent of GFLAG-0462 (919's DV is 87% post-death harm), which by itself would bar an unconditional reading. MECH-321's harm-aware-selection leg therefore has NO valid negative test. 844's weakens (a competence_implementation_gap reading) is the only remaining one. A re-test is meaningful only after the per-leaf harm input is made harm-informed (see the SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition amend).

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Make the per-leaf harm_penalty harm-informed before any harm-aware-selection re-test
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: V3-EXQ-1087 shows the built two-stage selection's per-leaf input discriminates the leaves but anti-tracks realised harm. (1) Read _decomposition_harm_penalty over the leaf-controlled rollout steps only, or roll leaves as multi-step sequences, not over zero-action-padded horizon states. (2) Require a harm/threat estimate that is trained or grounded in harm outcomes: the residue harm channel is written from z_harm.norm() on every tick, and E2's world head has no waking objective (GFLAG-0485/0491). (3) Enable or require valence bounding so Stage 1 does not sit at its clamp. This supersedes the 2026-08-13 amend's order of work: escapability or predictability channels added onto a non-harm-informed penalty would not be testable.
